integrity: The proof is a direct ZFC construction. A cofinal sequence of length \(\operatorname{cf}(\kappa)\) selects cofinally many fan branches; subsystem axioms, exact width, narrowness, and failure of well-pruning are checked symbolically with no experimental or computational premise.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only one-cardinal fans at singular height. It does not address two-cardinal trees, regular-height cases, or classify all singular-height trees admitting narrow subsystems without well-pruned subtrees. Because the construction is elementary, an equivalent folklore observation under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Singular-height fans admit narrow subsystems but no well-pruned subtree
